title: Filler: Yui's First Patient
later: Ren's ankle can wait a little... finish what you're doing, then come and help me.

offer.speaker: yui
offer.text: Ren fell in the lake one too many times and twisted his ankle. He says it's fine. It's not fine.

offer.speaker: yui
offer.text: I've got him as far as the hospital, but he won't go in. Can you meet us at the doors? He listens to you.

steps.text: Meet Yui and Ren in the hospital's waiting room

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: It's just a scratch! A ninja doesn't go to the hospital for a scratch!

dialogue.speaker: ren
dialogue.text: ...Fine. But if they give me a shot, I'm leaving.

choices.text: I'll race you once it's healed.

lines.speaker: ren
lines.text: You're ON. Yui, fix it fast!

dialogue.speaker: yui
dialogue.text: Thank you. Medical ninjutsu can only do so much... the patient has to let you help.

dialogue.speaker: yui
dialogue.text: Here. I made extra. If you're ever hurt, eat this.
